content_of_post_to_answer: How do I become stronger after losing a hundred times?
answer: Losing a hundred times only makes you stronger if you stop treating every loss as evidence about your ability and start treating it as information about your approach. Many people survive failure but repeat the same pattern, which only builds frustration. The real transformation happens when each loss changes your understanding, your strategy, or your standards. Strength is not built by the number of times you fall; it is built by how much wisdom you refuse to waste from each fall.
